qti-content-body.p: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.

Because the lab-grown diamond was formed from pure carbon with the exact same atomic structure as a natural stone, jewelers can only tell it's _____ using specialized equipment, never with the naked eye.

Correct! Synthetic specifically describes something made through a process that replicates a natural substance's true structure, which matches a lab-grown diamond with the same atomic structure as a natural one. Artificial is broader and more often describes something that merely imitates an appearance without necessarily matching the internal structure, like artificial flavoring. Fabricated carries an unwanted connotation of being falsely invented, and manufactured just means industrially made, without synthetic's specific chemical sense. Synthetic means made by chemical synthesis to replicate a natural substance, especially one that shares that substance's actual structure or properties.
